why_ai: Card acceptance and catalogue are commodities; payments rails and terminals persist but software layers face AI-native rivals.
why_clarity: Transactions, inventory counts and payouts are exact and recur millions of times.
why_digital: Cloud software and payment terminals sold to stores, processing physical-goods transactions.

why_ai: Network rules are published and evidence sits in the platform, so representment assembly is automatable.
why_clarity: Reason codes map to specified evidence, and each dispute is won or lost.
why_digital: Dispute notices, evidence and responses move entirely through card network systems.

why_ai: Identifying, pricing and listing unique items from photos is exactly what vision models now do.
why_clarity: Intake time is measurable, but pricing one-of-a-kind items involves taste.
why_digital: Starts from physical one-of-a-kind items brought into local stores.

why_ai: Invoice reconciliation and perishable markdown are structured tasks software automates.
why_clarity: A delivery invoice either matches what was left on the shelf or shows a variance.
why_digital: Paper delivery invoices and physical shelves feed software sold to local store owners.

why_ai: Adversarial classification with abundant outcome data is a model problem, under KYC obligations.
why_clarity: Approval decisions repeat at scale, though losses reveal bad approvals months later.
why_digital: Online applications and transaction data decisioned instantly in software.

why_ai: Discrepancy patterns are learnable and corrections mechanical, though counts happen on the shelf.
why_clarity: System stock either matches counted stock or it does not.
why_digital: Physical shelf counts reconciled against store, web and marketplace records.

why_ai: Payment rails remain needed, but underwriting and disputes are automatable decisions on transaction data.
why_clarity: Approvals, losses and dispute outcomes are measured across huge volumes.
why_digital: Payments, risk and merchant services run in software sold via ISOs and online.

why_ai: Populating specialty attributes from images and text is a direct fit for multimodal models.
why_clarity: Attribute completeness is countable, and the same products recur across thousands of merchants.
why_digital: Product data and images processed into catalogue records in software.

why_ai: Markdown and open-to-buy are well-posed planning problems on data the platform already holds.
why_clarity: Markdown and buying calls are judged by end-of-season sell-through and margin.
why_digital: Sales history in, buying and markdown recommendations out through retail software.

why_ai: Stock lookup, cycle counting and task lists are mechanical functions delivered by mobile software.
why_clarity: Lookups answer correctly or not, and tasks are completed or not.
why_digital: Tools carried on the sales floor support in-person customer service.

why_ai: Sharing POS sell-through with brands is a data-integration product, not protected human work.
why_clarity: Units sold per store per week is an exact, recurring report.
why_digital: Retailer POS data aggregated and delivered online to remote brands.
